from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the collection with its title and the other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper as found in the document")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the other provided papers that are referenced in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
